note: The ChatGPT plugin portal's screens as text: OpenAI's submission docs and their screenshots, read on 2026-11-13, and captures of the live portal from 2026-10-29 for the Findings panel, the Review information drawer's five steps and the Submit for review dialog. Where the two disagree (the docs number Reviewer credentials as the drawer's first step; the live portal puts Countries and translations first), the live portal wins. Display name, Short description and Starter prompts are the names the portal's own error messages use; Domain verification token and the reviewer check's fields, from Identity tool to Fixtures, are MCPJam's. Set checkedAgainstScreenshots to true only after a person has compared every line with the captures.
title: Upload new or existing plugin

steps.title: Upload your plugin ZIP
steps.intro: Compress your plugin folder into a .zip file before uploading

steps.title: Metadata & Skills
steps.intro: Package details are read-only here; edit them in your source package.

steps.title: MCPs
steps.intro: Your package can declare multiple MCP servers, but only one MCP server can be connected per plugin.

steps.title: Review information
steps.intro: Read-only fields are managed by your plugin ZIP. To change read-only information, update your plugin ZIP and upload it again.

steps.title: Publish your approved plugin
steps.intro: Open the approved package version and select Publish plugin.

errors.required: Display name is required, non-empty, and single-line.
errors.tooLong: Display name must be 30 characters or fewer.

errors.required: Short description is required, non-empty, and single-line.
errors.tooLong: Short description must be 30 characters or fewer.

errors.required: Long description is required and must be non-empty. Line breaks are allowed.
errors.tooLong: Long description must be 4,000 characters or fewer.
Developer name must be 80 characters or fewer.

mcp.verificationToken.label: Domain verification token
mcp.verificationToken.helper: The portal issues this token in its MCP step.

reviewer.identityTool.label: Identity tool
reviewer.identityTool.helper: MCPJam's own check, not part of the portal: a read-only tool on your server that returns the signed-in account. MCPJam calls it as the reviewer.

reviewer.identityArgs.label: Identity tool arguments
reviewer.identityArgs.helper: Fixed JSON arguments, if the identity tool takes any.

reviewer.expectedIdentityPath.label: Identity path
reviewer.expectedIdentityPath.helper: Where the tool's result names the account, as a JSON path.

reviewer.expectedIdentity.label: Expected reviewer
reviewer.expectedIdentity.helper: The account reviewers sign in as.

reviewer.expectedOrganizationPath.label: Organization path
reviewer.expectedOrganizationPath.helper: Where the tool's result names the organization or project, as a JSON path.

reviewer.expectedOrganization.label: Expected organization
reviewer.expectedOrganization.helper: The organization or project reviewers should land in.

reviewer.fixtures.label: Fixtures
reviewer.fixtures.helper: MCPJam's own check: resources your test cases name, each with a read-only tool call that finds it in the reviewer's account.

submit.additionalContext.label: Additional Submission Context
submit.additionalContext.helper: Add any additional information that might be useful for the review team, including justification for any findings. This optional note is private to the review.
